verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents API-based tax calculation during checkout using jurisdiction-aware boundary logic. It also documents address validation that maps transactions to the correct tax jurisdictions, supported by a CreateTransaction endpoint and REST v2 SDKs in six languages. However, it never explicitly claims rooftop-level accuracy over ZIP approximations and gives no latency or performance figures. missing for 10: explicit rooftop/geocode-level accuracy claim, documented response-time/latency suitable for checkout, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can calculate the right sales tax for a transaction through an API in real time — address-level (rooftop) accuracy, not ZIP-code approximations — fast enough to sit inside checkout

citations.quote: Calculate sales and use tax during checkout, invoicing, or order processing using jurisdiction-aware logic that reflects current tax rules and boundaries.
Validate addresses and map transactions to the correct tax jurisdictions to reduce errors caused by incomplete or inaccurate location data.
Records a new transaction in AvaTax. A transaction represents a unique potentially taxable action that your company has recorded
Avalara provides SDKs for the REST v2 APIs in the following languages: C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby
